value: Use the supplied facts and information to enhance and complete the affidavit.
Default party role: Applicant & Respondent, where no role is specified.
Use this to enhance the draft, {{facts}}.
Use this to enhance this affidavit, {{information}}.
Identify the deponent by name and appropriate personal description where supplied.
The subHeading may be adapted to the purpose of the affidavit, e.g. AFFIDAVIT IN SUPPORT OF ...
Where a third party is supplied, include the party and appropriate role in the BETWEEN/AND structure.
State facts as matters within the deponent's knowledge, information or belief as appropriate, without introducing unsupported facts.
End with the prescribed deposition/jurat wording and preserve the formal execution structure.
Use today's date where a date is required and none is supplied.
